text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Representatives of Tunisians abroad to meet on March 31 and April 1st for their annual conference.
- President Ben Ali conferred on Thursday with Foreign Minister Abderrahim Zouari who is to visit Rome on Friday.
- Bechir Mejdoub named director general of Political Affairs Department at the Interior Ministry.
- Tunisia aims at a 5.7 percent GDP growth in 1997.
- President Ben Ali asks Foreign Affairs Minister Zouari to boost efforts aiming at overcoming inter-African conflicts.
